title: Find the right website destination and guide without mistaking navigation for authority
goal: Use the shared website menus, footer and Docs discovery/recovery controls with exact source/version citations and truthful operational limits.
prerequisites: Internal source-only draft for the exact local preview, not the installed public release. No browser/media/AT/editorial/customer acceptance is established.
Source guides retain their historical pins49c5 and8a80. Their selected bytes match this new91520 snapshot; new sources are bound explicitly, not silently rebinding historical articles.
Supplemental to the older website-teaching-navigation draft; its conceptual/demo/skip coverage and historical bytes are preserved, not superseded.
permissions: Navigation, focus, filters and local menus grant no account, role, deployment, provider, AI-credit or approval authority. Destinations may load their own content/state and require current access.
Operational actions still require current exact authority, genuine independent review and one-attempt execution where applicable; a guide or simulated demo cannot approve them.
Source-derived public destinations do not permit new authentication, provider requests, consent, purchases, uploads or documentation publication.

steps.instruction: website.primary.skip: Activate Skip to content when it receives keyboard focus.
steps.expectedState: Requests both menus closed, focuses the first main, adding tabindex -1 only if absent; missing main has no destination. Real keyboard/AT/focus placement remains unaccepted.

steps.instruction: website.primary.home: Follow Vision XIX Labs home from the header.
steps.expectedState: Requests menu closure and navigates to /. Does not sign out or cancel ongoing work.

steps.instruction: website.primary.link: Choose Product, Integrations, Security, Docs or Demo from the wide header.
steps.expectedState: Follows that literal route, not an operational command or capability grant. Header presence is not destination health or deployed-version qualification.

steps.instruction: website.primary.more-toggle: Toggle More or press ArrowDown on its trigger.
steps.expectedState: Click toggles local disclosure; ArrowDown opens/focuses the first link. role=group is not a roving ARIA menu or focus trap. Escape and outside/blur behavior have separate limits.

steps.instruction: website.primary.more-link: Choose Pricing, Support (account required), Status or Company in More.
steps.expectedState: Requests local menu closure while following its route. /account/help separately requires browser identity; /status navigation does not establish service health.

steps.instruction: website.primary.signin-wide: Choose Sign in in the wide header.
steps.expectedState: Opens /auth/signin; this header does not inspect the current session. Visible label is not signed-out proof or completed login.

steps.instruction: website.primary.download-wide: Choose Download in the wide header.
steps.expectedState: Opens /download; no specific installer is selected or hash/signature checked by this link.

steps.instruction: website.primary.mobile-open: Open navigation menu at a narrow viewport.
steps.expectedState: Shows the full-screen dialog, closes More, makes only its header bar inert, captures/restores scroll styles and schedules initial Close focus. Not whole-page isolation.

steps.instruction: website.primary.mobile-close: Choose Close navigation menu in the narrow dialog.
steps.expectedState: Closes locally and schedules trigger focus. Blank space within the full-screen dialog is inside, not a separate backdrop close target.

steps.instruction: website.primary.mobile-link: Choose one of the ten narrow navigation destinations.
steps.expectedState: Uses five primary plus four secondary entries and Founding Supporters in preserved order; requests menu closure. Not an authenticated action catalogue.

steps.instruction: website.primary.signin-mobile: Follow Sign in from the narrow dialog.
steps.expectedState: Requests menu closure and opens the same browser sign-in route; no provider consent or device pairing is completed.

steps.instruction: website.primary.download-mobile: Follow Download from the narrow dialog.
steps.expectedState: Requests menu closure and opens /download; installation/session acceptance remains separate.

steps.instruction: website.footer.explore: Choose Explore Axiom in the footer.
steps.expectedState: Opens /product; starts no underlying operational pipeline or AI call through this handler.

steps.instruction: website.footer.supporters: Choose Founding Supporters in the footer.
steps.expectedState: Opens /support; distinct from account help and contact, not purchase/subscription or customer-ticket acceptance.

steps.instruction: website.footer.home: Follow the footer Vision XIX Labs link.
steps.expectedState: Navigates to / without signing out or altering account authority.

steps.instruction: website.footer.column-link: Choose a footer Product, Company or Legal link.
steps.expectedState: Fifteen literal records preserve two Security entries; supporters also has a separate CTA. Links do not attest current legal approval, pricing, support resolution or service readiness.

steps.instruction: website.docs.landing.task-link: On /docs choose a task under Get started, Complete a task, Look up a control or Resolve a problem.
steps.expectedState: Fifteen landing routes navigate to guides. Before following operational steps check installed-version and preview scope; page availability is not deployment permission.

steps.instruction: website.docs.contents.toggle: Use Documentation contents at narrow widths.
steps.expectedState: Initially collapsed disclosure toggles contents. At wide layout contents remain visible; it is not a modal. Opening does not itself focus search.

steps.instruction: website.docs.filter.query: Enter task words or a guide heading in Find a guide.
steps.expectedState: Local AND-substring match over catalogue label/section plus indexed literal summaries/headings; no article-body, private knowledge, AI, fuzzy ranking or request submission. Query can persist in the mounted layout.

steps.instruction: website.docs.filter.clear: Use Clear guide filter if the raw query is nonempty or matches nothing.
steps.expectedState: Clears local query and returns search focus, including whitespace-only input. Does not clear remote data or browser history.

steps.instruction: website.docs.sidebar.guide-link: Follow a matching guide in contents.
steps.expectedState: Twenty-three catalogue entries define the current search universe, not all28source pages. Exact pathname alone determines current-page semantics; a filter can hide the current guide.

steps.instruction: website.docs.article.previous: Follow Previous where an article supplies a previous link.
steps.expectedState: Uses that caller-provided label/href, not browser history or filtered results; absent previous metadata gives a noninteractive spacer.

steps.instruction: website.docs.article.next: Follow Next where an article supplies a next link.
steps.expectedState: Uses explicit caller metadata, not inferred sidebar ordering. Not every page mounts pagination, and source presence is not HTTP verification.

steps.instruction: website.docs.feedback.contact: Use Open support request in the Still blocked card.
steps.expectedState: Navigates to /contact; does not submit a ticket or helpfulness vote. Contact recording, email and resolution have their own gates; never include credentials in support material.

expectedOutcome: Locate an appropriate page/guide and understand the next supported boundary; no successful sign-in, installation, ticket, deployment, rollback or live service result is inferred.
limitations: Sixteen direct shared-navigation declarations and eight Docs families are finite source scopes, not all website body controls, runtime instances, operational capability or completed B4/B5.
More/mobile Escape handlers lack IME ownership guards; mobile Tab handling contains boundary traversal only and inertness covers the bar, not the whole page. Browser/AT/modal guarantees remain open.
Responsive home-focus recovery applies only when an open panel owned focus. Pathname closure does not promise query/hash-only or every hidden-trigger focus recovery.
Docs controlled focus/IME checks are distinct from actual browser behavior. The23sidebar and15landing records are not every Docs page; five source pages are outside the catalogue.

The imported heading index covers literal extracted metadata, not full bodies. Filtering does not perform freshness checks on each keystroke; explicit article pagination can differ from catalogue order.
No authentic media, genuine editorial approval, shipped-version qualification, executed retrieval or customer-approved answer exists in this article.
recovery: If a guide is hidden, clear/simplify the local filter. If the destination is unavailable, preserve the original task/outcome and find applicable help; do not infer no provider effect from a page failure.
Close a local menu deliberately; closure is not cancellation of requests from another page. Do not use account changes or navigation as an authorization/refusal workaround.
Uncertain or consumed operational actions must not be resent from guide instructions. Preserve the original record and use the separately approved supported observation/recovery process.
A missing source, wrong version or ineligible draft requires refusal/escalation, not substitution of an older article or invented approval.
